en: Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a stone city gate and tower beside a canal or moat. The round tower with a conical roof stands in the water, attached to a bridge and city wall. Leafless trees line the banks, and a few people and a horse-drawn vehicle are visible on the bridge. Printed text at the top identifies the scene as a view of Bruges and specifically La Porte Maréchal. A small printer's mark with letters and the word "Glogn" (partially legible) appears near the upper center.
